x-semantic-rules.requirement: Completed outcomes have null failure in both modes (trial_status). enumeration_complete requires exhausted (closure_reason), with no other new reason/basis matrix. choice_id and use_id share one namespace per scope, checked before seed use (duplicate_occurrence). Owner trial references are unique per containing Proposal immediate-parent Search, or per standalone Proposal when its immediate parent is Declaration, including nested Declarations; separate Searches may reuse them (duplicate_occurrence). OwnerEncoded is opaque: empty value_hex stays accepted; explicit resolution requires exact profile/version/value equality. Event identifier/hex/fingerprint grammar maps to event_schema; all outer field grammar maps to wire_schema before semantic checks. A valid differing completion capture_id maps to capture_id. Combined faults have no parity ordering promise.

At most one resolution occurrence refers to a scoped declaration. A second resolution refuses even if its value repeats. Independent effective seeds require distinct scoped declarations; restoration is in a new capture lineage.
